Copy this file to vX.Y.Z.md (matching the tag you're about to push) and fill
it in before tagging. The release workflow reads that file and refuses to

This content becomes the ONLY thing shown in the app's own update banner and
changelog view, so keep it to actual changes: features, improvements, bug
fixes. No install instructions, no Discord links, no download links — the
surrounding release template already covers all of that on GitHub, and a
user reading this inside the app already has it installed and running.

Emoji: default to none. A row of emoji-headed bullets reads as generated,
not written. Reach for one only when it's actually doing something — a
single emoji on the one feature worth calling out, not one per line. Most
releases should ship this file with zero emoji in it.

Delete whichever section doesn't apply. Delete this comment block too.
-->
